conventions.directions: 0=screen W (left), 1=NW (up-left), 2=N (up), 3=NE (up-right), 4=E (right), 5=SE (down-right), 6=S (down), 7=SW (down-left); clockwise on screen starting at screen-left. Flare map names: 0=SW,1=W,2=NW,3=N,4=NE,5=E,6=SE,7=S (map axes: +x = screen down-right, +y = screen down-left).
conventions.anchor: draw frame top-left at (feetScreenX - ox, feetScreenY - oy)
conventions.duration: duration_ms is the whole forward pass; frame_ms = duration_ms/frames; back_forth plays forward then reverse (cycle = 2*duration_ms)
conventions.activeFrameEffective: engine default when absent = floor((total-1)/2), total = frames (x2 for back_forth)
